newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed steady at 42.8470/8495 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday against the previous close at 42.8465/8495, dealers said.
The taka was quoted at 42.8470/8490 against the dollar in early trading, but failed to rise further as importers' demand for the greenback grew later in the day.
The interbank call money rates closed at 7.5 percent to eight percent against the previous 7.5 percent-8.5 percent.
